title: Utility Line Protection Plans Claims Adjudication Standard: Coverage Determination
content:
# Claims Adjudication Standard: Coverage Determination

Claims desk standard for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

One determination is issued per line service request. A line failure is covered only when every condition below holds, and otherwise is not covered with the first failing reason in this order.

1. **Contract not in force** — the plan was active on the request date.
2. **Waiting period** — the failure was first reported on or after the coverage effective date.
3. **Line not in plan** — the line type is in the plan's covered line types and its occurrence cap is above $0.00, a septic line only when the plan covers the septic line and a well line only when the plan covers the private well line.
4. **Utility-owned side** — the failure is on the homeowner's side of the connection point (failure location homeowner side); a utility-side failure is referred to the utility.
5. **Utility-mandated work** — work ordered by the utility or a government program is covered only when the plan covers utility-mandated work, and replacing a lead service line only when the plan covers lead line replacement.
6. **Preexisting condition** — a failure that began before the coverage effective date is never covered.
7. **Third-party damage** — damage by digging, construction or a third party is never covered.
8. **Excluded condition** — the failure is not one of the plan's excluded conditions; freezing is covered only when the plan covers frozen lines and tree roots only when the plan covers tree-root damage.

Each heading is the reason recorded when that condition fails.

## Applying the order

- The conditions are tested in the order listed. The reason recorded is the first that fails; later conditions are not reached.
- The failure location is recorded as homeowner side or utility side.
- Only one determination is issued for a service request.

## Worked cases (hypothetical requests)

| Facts | First failing condition | Determination |
|---|---|---|
| Plan suspended for nonpayment on the request date | 1 | not covered, contract not in force |
| Plan active; failure first reported before the coverage effective date | 2 | not covered, waiting period |
| Plan active, past the effective date; a gas line request on a plan whose gas line cap is $0.00, and the failure is also on the utility side | 3 | not covered, line not in plan |
| All of 1 to 4 hold; failure caused by tree roots on a plan that does not cover tree-root damage; no earlier condition fails | 8 | not covered, excluded condition |
| Every condition holds | none | covered |
